title: Balanced
summary: Everyday South African eating: a bit of everything, in the right amounts.
description: Built on South Africa's food-based dietary guidelines. Starch at most meals (mostly whole grain or coarse maize meal), beans, lentils or peas a few times a week, plenty of vegetables and fruit, and some protein at every meal. Portions are sized to your daily calories, so the same plan works for losing, keeping or gaining weight.
highlights: Starch at most meals, mostly whole grain
Beans, lentils or peas a few times a week
